note: group math is the closest of the five atlas groups (graphs and counting); the page is chemistry

description.zh: 同样的原子、不同的连接就是不同的分子：比如正丁烷与异丁烷原子数相同，骨架一直一拐，沸点就从约 0°C 变到约 −12°C；醇与醚、顺反异构也是同理，形状不同，性质就不同，计数时要用规范形式去重。不含环与手性。
description.en: The same atoms with different connections are different molecules: n-butane and isobutane share a formula, but a straight versus branched skeleton moves the boiling point from about 0 °C to about −12 °C. Alcohols versus ethers and cis–trans isomers work the same way — different shape, different properties — so counting uses canonical forms to avoid duplicates. No rings or chirality.

reason.zh: 异构体的骨架决定每个原子周围的键如何排布，沿用分子构型页的电子对排斥。
reason.en: A skeleton fixes how bonds sit around each atom, following the electron-pair repulsion of the molecular-shapes lesson.

label.en: The barrier decides whether it can turn

reason.zh: 单键的扭转能垒小、双键的大，e^(−ΔE/RT) 决定室温下能否越过，这就是顺反异构能分开的原因。
reason.en: Torsion barriers are small for single bonds and large for double bonds, and e^(−ΔE/RT) decides whether they can be crossed at room temperature, which is why cis and trans can be separated.

reason.zh: 骨架计数是组合问题：先生成所有可能，再用规范形式去重。
reason.en: Counting skeletons is a combinatorics problem: generate every possibility, then remove repeats with a canonical form.

title.zh: 同样的原子能拼出几种分子？
title.en: How many different molecules can the same atoms make?

ask.zh: 同一分子式可以有不同连接——数烷烃骨架时，怎样避免把同一种结构数两遍？
ask.en: One formula can connect in different ways — when counting alkane skeletons, how do you avoid counting the same structure twice?

ask.zh: 醇和醚原子数相同，连接不同——官能团不同，性质会一样吗？
ask.en: An alcohol and an ether can share the same atoms with different connections — do different functional groups mean different properties?

ask.zh: 顺反异构形状不同——形状不同，分子性质和作用会不同吗？
ask.en: Cis–trans isomers differ in shape — does a different shape mean different properties and behaviour?

reveal.zh: 同样的原子、不同的连接就是不同的分子；骨架、官能团、顺反形状都不同，性质也就不同，计数时要用规范形式去重。
reveal.en: Same atoms with different connections are different molecules; skeleton, functional group and cis–trans shape all change properties, and counting needs canonical forms to avoid duplicates.
